title: BDP Callables version 1 structural projections
$comment: Feature-owned supplement to unchanged BDP v0.1. Shape validation does not establish support, authorization or implementation conformance.

callablesCapabilityV1.description: Version-1 detail of the Callables capability: where this Scope's Callables are invoked, and its registry Bead when it registers them.

invoke.description: Absolute HTTP(S) base URL; a Callable's mount is this base, a slash and its name.

registry.description: URL of the Scope's registry Bead, when it registers its Callables.

callablesDiscovery.description: A Core or Write discovery document that advertises Callables version 1 with its closed detail.

callableInvocation.description: The closed invocation body. The mount supplies the operation; no operation, name or key member rides in the body.

arguments.description: Object keyed by parameter name; an empty object when the declaration has no parameters.

definition.description: The declaration revision the client parsed; a mismatch with the current revision is callable-revision-mismatch.

revisionProvenance.description: Write's attribution input, admitted on a CallableBatch invocation and carried onto every revision the batch commits; rejected on a CallableQuery.

callableResult.description: The closed success body of an invocation: the exact declaration revision that ran, the result value, and for a CallableBatch whether anything committed.

callable.description: Pinned Reference to the exact declaration revision that ran.

changed.description: CallableBatch only, then required: true when the batch committed any durable effect, else false.

result.description: Any JSON value; the declaration's result schema, when there is one, says what to expect.

callableProblemMembers.description: The members of a Problem whose code this profile adds. Core's and Write's codes keep their own shapes; an invocation Problem is one or the other.

code.description: One of the four codes this profile adds.

error.description: Required with callable-error, absent otherwise: the operation's own error value, valid against the declaration's error schema when there is one.

retry.description: Always after-state-change for these four codes.

callableProblem.description: A Problem answered by a mount: a Core or Write Problem, or one carrying a code this profile adds.
